constraints.name: appointments_service_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: no_overlapping_appointments
constraints.def: EXCLUDE USING gist (tstzrange(start_time, end_time) WITH &&) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['ceka'::text, 'potvrdjen'::text])))

triggers.name: trg_appointments_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER trg_appointments_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.appointments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
